text: Running to Represent the People of Manatee, Pinellas, Hardee, Polk and DeSoto Counties in Congress (FL-16)

heading: OuR Campaign is growing fast
text: In less than a year, this campaign has grown from a simple message of truth into a movement followed by more than 200,000 people across the country . What started as one voice refusing to stay quiet has become a community of Americans who believe courage, honesty, and compassion still belong in our politics.

heading: OuR Campaign is growing fast
text: We’re leading with truth, courage, and love ….and people are responding. Every day more neighbors, veterans, teachers, parents, and small business owners are stepping forward to say enough is enough and join this campaign.

heading: OuR Campaign is growing fast
text: The impact is personal too. Even members of my own family who once supported donald trump have seen the damage being done and now stand behind this campaign and the values we’re fighting for.

heading: OuR Campaign is growing fast
text: It’s about building a movement strong enough to restore integrity, accountability, and hope to our country.

heading: OuR Campaign is growing fast
text: Please donate and sign our petition. Thank you!

heading: My Name is MArk Davis
text: I’m not your typical politician—and that’s exactly the point.

heading: My Name is MArk Davis
text: I’m a veteran, a husband, a dad, and a small business owner who’s spent his life working hard and standing up for what’s right. I served eight years in the US Air Force , where I learned the importance of discipline, service, and putting others first. After that, I spent 16 years in corporate America leading high-stakes operations for one of the nation’s largest retailers—solving problems, building teams, and getting things done.

heading: My Name is MArk Davis
text: Now I live here in Florida with my wife, Sarah—my high school sweetheart —and our two kids. We love this state, but like so many families, we’re feeling the squeeze. Prices keep rising, wages are flat , and too many politicians seem more interested in scoring points than solving problems.

heading: My Name is MArk Davis
text: I’ve had enough of that—and I know I’m not alone.

heading: My Name is MArk Davis
text: I’m running for Congress because I believe we deserve better. I want to bring common sense, honesty, and accountability back to government—and make Washington work for us again.

heading: My Name is MArk Davis
text: I’m not here to climb the political ladder. I’m here to lift people up.

heading: My Name is MArk Davis
text: Join me in the fight for a stronger, fairer Florida—and a future we can be proud of.

heading: Stand Up. Speak Out. Join the Fight.
text: This campaign isn’t about playing politics—it’s about defending democracy, protecting working families, and standing up to fascism in every form. Mark Davis is fighting for truth, justice, and the America we know we can be. If you’re ready to take a stand, now’s the time.

heading: Stand Up. Speak Out. Join the Fight.
text: Join the fight. Let’s build something better—together.

heading: MAKE A DONATION
text: If you’re ready to fight for a better future with me, will you donate to our campaign today?

heading: What I’m Fighting For
text: Common Sense Over Chaos. Truth Over BS. Florida Over the Billionaires.

heading: What I’m Fighting For
text: I’m not a career politician—I’m a veteran, a dad, and a small business guy who’s tired of watching regular people get crushed while the powerful keep cashing in. These are the fights that matter to me—and to the people of Florida’s 16th District.

heading: Working Families
text: Look, first and foremost, let’s not sugarcoat it: the economy is in the toilet . And no, it’s not just some Wall Street rollercoaster that you can ignore. We’re talking real people’s lives: rents are climbing, wages are stuck, insurance costs are blowing up, and property taxes are rising while home values sink.

heading: Working Families
text: Tariffs are just gasoline on that fire. So, the line is simple: the so-called “economic revival” is a mirage.

heading: Working Families
text: We need policies that actually lift everyday Floridians up, not just hand gold bars to the billionaires.

heading: Immigration & Crime: Facts Over Fear
text: Here’s where we cut through the noise. Trump’s fantasy of a “migrant invasion” and a “crime wave” is just that—a fantasy. Crime exists and immigration issues are real, but these are problems we can address without turning America into a North Korea knockoff .

heading: Immigration & Crime: Facts Over Fear
text: You don’t destroy democracy to fix a problem that requires all of us to fix. We’re not going to militarize our streets just because someone’s peddling fear.

heading: Immigration & Crime: Facts Over Fear
text: We solve these issues with smart policies and respect for liberty, not paranoia and propaganda.

heading: Healthcare for all
text: Let’s get real: Republicans have turned healthcare into a horror show. They’ve convinced people to vote against their own well-being. We’re here to say: no more.

heading: Healthcare for all
text: Universal healthcare isn’t some scary monster—it’s common sense. The current patchwork of employer-based or profit-driven plans is a failure.

heading: Healthcare for all
text: We need a system that actually covers everyone without bankrupting them. Period.

heading: Democracy
text: And, about democracy? We’ve got to stop this top-down nonsense.

heading: Democracy
text: Democracy isn’t a command center. It’s a ground-level movement. When you let a handful of people at the top dictate everything, you squash the voices of everyday Americans.

heading: Democracy
text: Our campaign stands for a democracy where everyone’s a stakeholder, not just a chosen few. In America, there’s no office more important than that of citizen.

heading: Common sense over chaos: Abortion & Guns
text: Let’s cut through the noise: most Americans agree we need common sense on both abortion and guns. But, Donald Trump and the extremists on the right AND left have turned these issues into political footballs: weaponized for division, distraction, and power grabs.

heading: Common sense over chaos: Abortion & Guns
text: Nobody wants the government forcing birth. Nobody wants unstable people walking into schools with AR-15s. But that’s exactly what we’re getting, because the loudest voices treat every conversation like a culture war instead of a chance to fix what’s broken.

heading: Common sense over chaos: Abortion & Guns
text: We can protect reproductive freedom and protect public safety. These aren’t radical ideas—they’re mainstream. But, under Trump’s influence, the government has made “freedom” mean forcing women into childbirth and flooding our neighborhoods with unregulated guns.

heading: Common sense over chaos: Abortion & Guns
text: That’s not freedom. That’s chaos. And, we’re done pretending it makes sense.
